title: A rebrand pitch the owner turns down
transcript:
Jordan Lee (Northwind Studio): We put together a new look for the storefront.
Jordan Lee (Northwind Studio): The full rebrand is $2,000 and we can start Monday.
Helena Cruz (owner): I can't approve two thousand. Let's stop there.

traps.description: Northwind proposes $2,000 and Helena says she cannot approve it.
